concerns.text: Tasks T012/T013 hardcode N=200 and fail if <200 examples are found. Spec FR-002 mandates a target of 500 but explicitly requires proceeding with a minimum of 10 examples if 500 are unavailable, logging a warning instead of failing. The task logic silently weakens the spec's fallback acceptance criterion.

Tasks T013 and T018 implement the Oracle and Feature extraction using 'Phi-3-mini' and 'sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2' respectively. While noted as 'Plan Overrides', the Spec FR-002 and FR-003 explicitly define the Oracle as 'Llama-3-1B' and the semantic similarity model as 'sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2' (which matches) but the Spec's 'Static Feature Vector' entity definition implies a specific embedding source context. More critically, the Plan explicitly defines the Oracle as 'Llama-3-1B' (not Phi-3-mini). The tasks implement a different model (Phi-3-mini) without a corresponding update to the Spec's FR-002 text, creating a semantic drift where the task deliverable (Phi coefficients) does not match the Spec's defined entity (Llama coefficients).

Tasks T028/T028a implement a SHAP-based threshold derivation and logic to distinguish 'signal is emergent' vs 'features are poor proxies'. Spec FR-008 and the Edge Cases section explicitly mandate using 'Permutation Importance' scores (threshold < 0.01) for this classification. The tasks replace the mandated method with a different algorithm (SHAP) without updating the Spec, violating the requirement to use the specified metric for the classification decision.

Task T026b describes generating a 'uniform weight vector scaled to match the variance of the true coefficients'. Spec FR-005 and SC-001 require comparing against a 'uniform-weight baseline' (implying uniform weights, e.g., 1/N or constant) and a random baseline (N(0,1)). Scaling the uniform baseline to match the target variance alters the definition of the baseline specified in the requirements, potentially invalidating the statistical comparison intended by the spec.

The Plan (Phase 3.2) explicitly mandates implementing 'Kendall's Tau' correlations and '95% Confidence Intervals via Bootstrap'. Tasks T026 and T027 only describe implementing Spearman correlation and a permutation test. The tasks omit the implementation of Kendall's Tau and Bootstrap CI, dropping acceptance criteria defined in the Plan which serves as the execution authority for the tasks.

Task T018a creates a persistent `reference_set.parquet` file for semantic similarity. Spec FR-003 defines the reference set as a '[deferred] stratified GSM8K solution traces' without specifying the creation of a separate, persistent artifact. While not strictly forbidden, the task introduces a new artifact and persistence step not mandated by the Spec or Plan, potentially violating the 'no silent constitution drift' principle by adding scope not authorized by the requirements.
